summary: The site has the basics right on the homepage and a strong FAQ page, but a cross-domain canonical on the main blog post, a noindex draft in the sitemap and no structured data on the FAQ and contact pages hold back both classic and AI search. Fix the canonical first, then add FAQPage and LocalBusiness schema; both are one-file changes. AI bots are blocked by policy — a decision for the owner, not a defect.

drivers: /services.html has two <h1> and shares its meta description with /pricing.html
About page names leadership and accreditations but ships no Person / Organization link
GPTBot and CCBot blocked in robots.txt — owner decision, caps citation reach
Blog post has a byline + Person schema; no author page exists
/faq.html has six question H2s with 40–60-word answers and no FAQPage schema
/contact.html shows NAP and hours without LocalBusiness schema
Pricing has a comparison table; no direct-answer sentence under the H1
